title: Villager Trading Helper

# Villager Trading Helper

A client-side Fabric mod that replaces the vanilla villager trading screen with a faster trade browser, smart filters, favorites, and safer bulk trading.

## Overview
Villager Trade Helper replaces the vanilla villager trading screen with a larger, faster interface built for players who trade a lot.

Instead of digging through a long vertical list one trade at a time, you get a clean trade browser that helps you scan offers quickly, find the ones you actually want, and trade with fewer clicks.

![Villager Trading Helper UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efb24a212ed78e46ff4d9463355923e98cefcb8d.png)

## Features
- Replaces the vanilla villager UI with a larger custom trade screen
- Shows trades in a grid layout for easier browsing
- Sorts trades by smart order, cheapest, most possible, or alphabetical
- Filters trades by all trades, affordable trades, favorites, or books
- Shows how many times each trade can be completed with your current inventory
- Marks discounted and out-of-stock trades at a glance
- Saves favorite trades globally so they stay marked between sessions
- Includes quick bulk actions like `Trade Max` and `Trade Amount`
- Supports optional auto-trading for the currently filtered category (coming soon)
- Uses conservative stop conditions and delays to reduce bad bulk-trade behavior and desync issues

## Why use it?
Villager trading gets tedious fast, especially with librarians and high-level villagers. This mod is meant to make trading clearer and faster without turning it into a completely different system. You still use normal villager trades, just with a better screen and better tools.
